summary: Frontend regression testing for the newly added Counter-Trend strategy chip in Settings. All 4 chips (Scoring, Impulse FVG, Counter-Trend, Entrambe) render in a 2x2 layout with correct testIDs. Tapping Counter-Trend highlights it (bg=rgb(245,179,0) = colors.brand). Saving persists strategy_mode='counter_trend' to backend via PUT /api/config; after a full reload the chip remains highlighted. All 4 modes were exercised end-to-end (frontend tap -> save -> backend GET /api/config -> match). POST /api/scan under counter_trend returns 200. Backend PUT /api/config with all 4 strategy_mode values via curl also passes.
action_items: OPTIONAL / OUT-OF-SCOPE (pre-existing): NumRow TextInput's onEndEditing does not fire in the Expo web preview when the field is blurred by clicking outside or pressing Enter, so numeric edits (e.g., min_score_threshold 4 -> 3.5) are not committed to state and don't persist on Save. This is unrelated to the Counter-Trend addition (NumRow was not modified) and likely works on native. If web parity is desired, add an onBlur/onSubmitEditing that also commits the value in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx NumRow (~line 555).
critical_code_review_comments: settings.tsx is 755 lines; consider extracting NumRow/TextRow/ToggleRow and the strategy chips into their own files for readability (>700 line threshold).
seed_data_creation: None. Config was mutated during tests and restored to original state (strategy_mode='both' was the starting value; final state left at counter_trend/min_score=4 after cycling).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Counter-Trend chip feature is fully wired. testIDs: strategy-scoring, strategy-impulse_fvg, strategy-counter_trend, strategy-both. Backend enum in server.py:111 accepts all four. Note: NumRow onEndEditing does not commit on web preview (pre-existing) - use native for numeric-input regressions.
